graph_decision.evidence: J1 (index 491) shows a sharp upward step in N, E, and U; J2 (index 524) shows a sharp downward step of similar magnitude in all three components, returning displacement close to pre-J1 baseline. The subtracted auxiliary plots confirm the transient nature: after removing slow trajectory, the spike at J1 is followed by oscillatory decay and a matching negative spike at J2, with residual noise afterward. No persistent offset remains post-J2, supporting a single transient event with onset and return. No other standalone steps are visible.
